csv_project_name: CM/CS Services for CIP and Special Maintenance Project
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Hawaii, Department of Transportation (HDOT), Harbors Division is seeking qualified engineering firms to provide Statewide, Construction Management and Construction Support (CM/CS) Services, Job No. Q90218. The work involves Capital Improvement Project (CIP) and Special Maintenance Project (SMP) specific CM/CS Services of various State Harbors projects and will consist of providing such services on an as-required basis. The selected consultants will provide construction managers, project engineers, field engineers, field construction inspectors, field clerks and/or schedulers on an as-required work order basis to supplement the State Harbors Engineering construction staff to properly administer various CIP and SMP construction projects.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Land Use Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Public Transit Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning

- Primarily a construction management/construction support services contract, not structural design.
